concept.title: Opened files and copies
concept.shortdesc: On a computer, uFTi works on the file you open, so make a copy first if you want the original left alone.

conbody.p: When you open a family tree file, works on that file. It does not make a copy for itself. It saves each change to the file you opened.

section.title: Leave the original alone
section.p: The file you open changes as you work. If you want the original left alone, work on a copy. Make the copy before you change anything. Then open the copy, and keep the original safe.

section.title: Make a copy
section.p: Choose on the card for your tree. asks where to put the copy, and then tells you where it went.

A copy made this way is a saved copy. It is a file of its own, and it stays as it was when you made it. does not move you to the copy. It keeps working on the file you opened. To work on the copy, open it.

section.title: Files beside your tree
section.p: also keeps other files beside your tree. One kind is a backup, an older copy of your tree. Another has V7 in its name and holds the same tree again. makes them for you. says what each one is.

section.title: Sending your tree
section.p: Send a copy that you saved, and not one of the other files. says why.
